description: Binding append-only authority for reviewed immutable iOS and Portal client artifacts. A source commit, branch head, CI build, marketing version or artifact digest alone never creates an approved client baseline. The writer verifies external artifact bytes and reviewed metadata but never creates approvals or production readiness.
requiredEvidenceClasses: exact external client artifact bytes and recomputed digest
build provenance linked to source commit and client class
deletion-fence and retry/idempotency behavior relevant to the client
registrationGuards: input record and client artifact are outside the repository working tree
repository working tree is clean before mutation
artifact SHA-256 and byte length are recomputed from supplied bytes
artifact digest is not already registered under another baseline
source commit is an ancestor of current HEAD
all evidence references are repository-relative tracked regular files, contain no symlink component, existed at sourceCommitSha, and current bytes exactly match the source-commit blob
historical registered evidence is revalidated against each record sourceCommitSha before any later append
three required approval roles use distinct operational pseudonyms
registry update uses the canonical exclusive append lock and atomic replacement
registry is revalidated after append and original bytes are restored if canonical validation fails
registry validator and Git review remain mandatory after mutation
forbiddenRecordContent: raw user content or account/session/job identifiers
claims that baseline approval proves client/server skew
claims that baseline approval proves production readiness
